metadata.title: SDLC Assurance
metadata.remarks: SDLC Assurance defines the capability to provide security and policy assurance within the software delivery lifecycle through secure development practices, automated and manual testing, and evidence generation. This pattern ensures assurance is produced prior to production release and preserved for auditability but does not authorize changes or control runtime behavior.

components.title: Secure Development Practices
components.description: Definition and enforcement of secure coding and development standards within delivery pipelines.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Require secure programming practices to reduce the likelihood of exploitable vulnerabilities.

components.title: Automated and Manual Testing
components.description: Execution of security testing such as SAST, DAST, SCA, and manual review prior to release.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Perform automated and manual security testing during software development and delivery.

components.title: Assurance Evidence Generation
components.description: Generation and preservation of evidence demonstrating compliance with security and policy requirements.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Generate and maintain evidence of security testing and assurance activities.
